content.what_it_is: MATLAB R2010b가 생성한 단일 페이지 EPS 시계열 비교 도표다. 가로축은 270-295초, 세로축은 0-14cm 범위이며 파란색과 빨간색 polyline 계열을 겹쳐 그린다. 파일 경로는 case_A지만 내부 제목은 'Case B (H/d=0.0.0378)'라고 표기한다.
entities: MathWorks PostScript prolog and drawing operators (lines 12-166)
page, object, coordinate, and color setup (lines 168-196)
plot frame, grid, ticks, and tick labels (lines 197-281)
unresolved: The path and DSC title identify case_A/comp_beach_A_v20, but the visible plot title on line 1038 says Case B.
The visible title's H/d value is written as 0.0.0378, which is not a valid numeric literal and appears to contain an extra '0.'.
The x and y units are sec and cm, but the plotted variable names are absent.
Blue c8 and red c9 curves are drawn without a legend, so their source identities cannot be recovered from the EPS.
The generated EPS contains encoded relative path geometry but no source dataset names or plotting configuration, preventing semantic reconstruction of individual series.
